market_note: USD stablecoin market cap has jumped 30% (+$71B) to roughly $308B, even as Tether's USDT supply shrank ~$4B over the past 60 days.

stablecoin_items.headline: Tether Says KPMG Completed Its First Full Audit
stablecoin_items.summary: Tether announced KPMG finished an independent audit of its financial statements for the first time, though it hasn't released the report publicly.

stablecoin_items.headline: Circle Launches cirBTC, a Regulated Wrapped Bitcoin
stablecoin_items.summary: Circle debuted cirBTC, a 1:1 BTC-backed token custodied under its OCC-supervised trust bank, verified via Chainlink Proof of Reserve.

stablecoin_items.headline: Circle Shares Slide on Revenue Miss
stablecoin_items.summary: Circle stock posted its worst day in months on Aug 12 after a revenue miss, though analysts still see upside as stablecoin volumes hit record highs.

stablecoin_items.headline: TRM Labs Traces $6.3B Through Sanctioned Shelbit Network
stablecoin_items.summary: Investigators tracked $6.3B moving through Shelbit following OFAC sanctions on Aug 7, with 88% flowing as dollar stablecoins on Tron.

hack_items.headline: Crypto Whale Loses $25.6M in Repeat Wallet Hack
hack_items.summary: An attacker drained a whale's wallet of wBTC, cbBTC, LDO and CRV on Aug 13, converting proceeds to DAI and ETH; the same address was hit in 2023.

hack_items.headline: Coldcard Hardware Wallet Exploit Damage Reaches $130M
hack_items.summary: A five-year-old firmware flaw in Coinkite's Coldcard device has been exploited since July 30, draining over 5,200 addresses across four waves.

hack_items.headline: Coinsbuy Hit by $7.9M Crypto Hack
hack_items.summary: Exchange Coinsbuy reported a $7.9M breach, with attackers laundering stolen funds into Monero, part of a wider 2026 theft spree topping $972M.

hack_items.headline: Two Separate Hacks Drain Over $51M via Key Compromises
hack_items.summary: A pair of incidents tied to compromised private keys resulted in a combined $51M+ in losses, underscoring persistent key-management risks.
